text: Objective: Through study, students could learn Tai Ji, Mantis Boxing, Gave Mulan Boxing, and Sanda of Wushu etc. Besides wushu learning, students could also grasp basic Chinese communication ability and lay the foundation for further learning Chinese traditional wushu essence and Chinese traditional culture. Characteristic: Taught in Chinese and English Courses: Chinese Pronunciation, Chinsese Vocabulary, Chinese Grammar, Chinese Reading, Chinese Writing, Chinese Listening, Oral Chinese, Tai Ji, Mantis Boxing, Gave Mulan Boxing, and Sanda of Wushu etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.
